# States Reference

Source: Junaid/templates/states.md (STRONG_HEURISTIC)

## Purpose
Interactive and asynchronous states: hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, empty, error.

## Guidelines
1. Every interactive element must define distinct hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states.
2. Asynchronous actions must display skeleton loaders, spinners, or loading states.
3. Empty states must provide explanatory text and a clear call to action.
4. Error states must highlight the problematic field/section with actionable recovery messaging.
